post.description: Records the DISPATCHED tracking event and SHIPMENT_DISPATCHED. info.title: Rasta — Inventory Service
info.description: Inventory and forward logistics (COM-006, ADR-056). Warehouses — of any organization, never assumed to be a union — and, per product and warehouse, a stock item whose balance (on hand, reserved, available = on hand − reserved) changes only through an append-only ledger of movements: RECEIPT, ADJUSTMENT, and the RESERVE / RELEASE / ISSUE of reservations. Every command is one transaction that locks the stock items it touches in ascending id order (PostgreSQL row locks, no Redis — ADR-056 § 4), so the balance, its movement and its event commit together; the database refuses a negative or over-reserved balance and any balance that does not equal the sum of its movements. Everything is the warehouse owner’s: another organization gets 404. Every command requires an Idempotency-Key. Products, orders and purchase orders are opaque references to the services that own them (Q-105); quantities are whole numbers of a product’s base unit. Shipments leave an owner’s warehouse for a consignee organization, CREATED → DISPATCHED → DELIVERED with a tracking event for each, moved only by the owner and read by the owner and the consignee alone (ADR-056 § 2, § 5); a shipment moves no stock.
